category_tips.biology: 蛋白质名用标准基因符号（ERK1/2, MAPK, MEK）；激活用实线箭头，抑制用 T 型虚线；磷酸化用红色圆圈 P 标记；跨膜蛋白嵌入脂双层示意
category_tips.medicine: 疾病相关突变位点用星号标注；药物靶点用虚线框圈出；临床意义用脚注说明
category_tips.chemistry: 小分子配体用化学结构式表示；结合位点用口袋图示；Kd/Ki 值标在箭头上

examples: Scientific signaling pathway diagram, MAPK-ERK cascade, top-to-bottom vertical layout: receptor tyrosine kinase at top embedded in lipid bilayer (blue #3b82f6), RAS-GTP node, RAF-MEK-ERK sequential phosphorylation marked with red circled P, nuclear translocation arrow into nucleus at bottom showing gene transcription activation. Activation arrows solid green #10b981, inhibition arrows T-bar dashed red #ef4444. Protein names in bold Arial. White background. 4K, Nature journal publication style, flat vector illustration.

Apoptosis signaling pathway mechanism diagram, intrinsic and extrinsic pathways converging on caspase-3 activation. Extrinsic: death receptor Fas with FADD and caspase-8. Intrinsic: Bcl-2 family, mitochondrial cytochrome c release, apoptosome with caspase-9. Solid green arrows for activation, T-bar dashed red for inhibition. Mitochondria drawn as oval with inner membrane folds. White background, labeled nodes, 4K, textbook illustration style with annotation callout boxes.

PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling cascade infographic, horizontal left-to-right flow, growth factor receptor at left, PI3K converts PIP2 to PIP3, AKT phosphorylation marked, mTORC1 complex at right regulating protein synthesis. Icon-based proteins, vibrant educational color palette, bilingual labels 磷酸化 (Phosphorylation). 4K resolution.
accuracy_tips: 对照 KEGG/UniProt 验证蛋白质名和相互作用；激活用实线绿色箭头，抑制用 T 型虚线红色；磷酸化位点标红色圆圈 P；跨膜蛋白必须嵌入脂双层；不可虚构蛋白质相互作用或通路分支；方向必须明确（top-to-bottom 或 left-to-right）。
